marketing.subhead: Each night, a scenario drops. Strangers argue. Someone is on the wrong side of the room. Five minutes. One verdict.

welcome.body: Six strangers. One scenario. Five minutes to decide who got it right.

interests.title: What do you care about?
interests.subtitle: Pick five. This is what we send to the courtroom you join.

region.title: Where are you reading from?

alias.title: Choose your alias.
alias.subtitle: This is who you are inside the courtroom. Choose carefully — you cannot change it for thirty days.

avatar.title: Pick a mark.
avatar.subtitle: This is what other jurors see beside your verdict.

tutorial.title: One practice round.
